Change in the CHC profile in separated callow F. sanguinea ants

Tomasz Włodarczyk

26-11-2023

suppressMessages({
  library(sangchem)
  library(dplyr)
  library(lmerTest)
})

# load data
data("separation_experiment_data")
data("mass_spectra_data")

Change in the totcal CHC amount over time

separation_data <- filter(separation_experiment_data, treatment_id<5)

lm_model <- lmer(I(sqrt(corrected_mass))~mean_delta+(1|colony), data = separation_data[-74,])

print(summary(lm_model))
## Linear mixed model fit by REML. t-tests use Satterthwaite's method ['lmerModLmerTest']
## Formula: I(sqrt(corrected_mass)) ~ mean_delta + (1 | colony)
##    Data: separation_data[-74, ]
## 
## REML criterion at convergence: -12.9
## 
## Scaled residuals: 
##      Min       1Q   Median       3Q      Max 
## -2.54596 -0.65494 -0.04106  0.63627  2.54062 
## 
## Random effects:
##  Groups   Name        Variance Std.Dev.
##  colony   (Intercept) 0.01293  0.1137  
##  Residual             0.03516  0.1875  
## Number of obs: 79, groups:  colony, 11
## 
## Fixed effects:
##              Estimate Std. Error        df t value Pr(>|t|)    
## (Intercept)  1.180332   0.047605 16.450772  24.794 1.83e-14 ***
## mean_delta   0.002458   0.001669 68.538937   1.473    0.145    
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## 
## Correlation of Fixed Effects:
##            (Intr)
## mean_delta -0.518
# model diagnostics
hist(residuals(lm_model))

shapiro.test(residuals(lm_model))
## 
##  Shapiro-Wilk normality test
## 
## data:  residuals(lm_model)
## W = 0.99204, p-value = 0.9107
simulationOutput <- simulateResiduals(fittedModel = lm_model, plot = FALSE)
plot(simulationOutput)

Change in the amount of compunds associated with callow F. sanguinea

load_globals()
separation_data$corrected_mass_part <- separation_data$corrected_mass * subsample_proportion(peaks_callow, separation_data$chromatogram_ID)
lm_model <- lmer(corrected_mass_part~mean_delta+(1|colony)+I(mean_delta^2), data = separation_data)
print(summary(lm_model))
## Linear mixed model fit by REML. t-tests use Satterthwaite's method ['lmerModLmerTest']
## Formula: corrected_mass_part ~ mean_delta + (1 | colony) + I(mean_delta^2)
##    Data: separation_data
## 
## REML criterion at convergence: -66.4
## 
## Scaled residuals: 
##      Min       1Q   Median       3Q      Max 
## -1.73399 -0.58595  0.00875  0.48372  3.11530 
## 
## Random effects:
##  Groups   Name        Variance Std.Dev.
##  colony   (Intercept) 0.003386 0.05819 
##  Residual             0.015192 0.12326 
## Number of obs: 80, groups:  colony, 11
## 
## Fixed effects:
##                   Estimate Std. Error         df t value Pr(>|t|)    
## (Intercept)      2.983e-01  3.636e-02  4.431e+01   8.202 1.96e-10 ***
## mean_delta       9.621e-03  4.271e-03  6.813e+01   2.252   0.0275 *  
## I(mean_delta^2) -2.020e-04  9.951e-05  6.869e+01  -2.030   0.0462 *  
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## 
## Correlation of Fixed Effects:
##             (Intr) mn_dlt
## mean_delta  -0.735       
## I(mn_dlt^2)  0.644 -0.968
shapiro.test(residuals(lm_model))
## 
##  Shapiro-Wilk normality test
## 
## data:  residuals(lm_model)
## W = 0.96998, p-value = 0.05662
simulationOutput <- simulateResiduals(fittedModel = lm_model, plot = FALSE)
plot(simulationOutput)

Change in the amount of compunds associated with F. sanguinea

separation_data$corrected_mass_part <- separation_data$corrected_mass * subsample_proportion(peaks_sang, separation_data$chromatogram_ID)

print(summary(lm_model))
## Linear mixed model fit by REML. t-tests use Satterthwaite's method ['lmerModLmerTest']
## Formula: I((corrected_mass_part)) ~ I((mean_delta)^(1.5)) + (1 | colony)
##    Data: separation_data[-c(69, 74), ]

## REML criterion at convergence: 51.6
##

##      Min       1Q   Median       3Q      Max 
## -2.46116 -0.72124 -0.03621  0.48469  3.09244

##  colony   (Intercept) 0.00811  0.09006 
##  Residual             0.08574  0.29282 
## Number of obs: 78, groups:  colony, 11
## 
## Fixed effects:
##                        Estimate Std. Error        df t value Pr(>|t|)    
## (Intercept)           5.660e-01  5.193e-02 1.851e+01  10.900 1.72e-09 ***
## I((mean_delta)^(1.5)) 2.402e-03  3.886e-04 7.098e+01   6.182 3.58e-08 ***
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## 
## Correlation of Fixed Effects:
##             (Intr)
## I((_)^(1.5) -0.546

shapiro.test(residuals(lm_model))

##  Shapiro-Wilk normality test

plot(simulationOutput)
